events.detail_full_en: Due to the effects of a person-hit-by-train incident at Minami-dai Station, a suspension of services was in place between Takahata Fudo and Keio Hachioji Stations. However, services resumed around 01:25. Please note that train delays and service suspensions are still occurring.
